sections.title: General Rules
items: GiftMe.ge is a promo platform that allows users to collect stars and exchange them for desired vouchers.
Registration on the site is free.
Users must be 18 years or older to use the site.

sections.title: Registration & Account
items: During registration, users must provide their first name, last name, phone number, and date of birth.
Only one account can be created per phone number.
Users are responsible for the security of their accounts.

sections.title: Star System
items: A promo code can only be used once, before stars are spent.
The number of stars received from promo activities is variable.
Users receive 5 stars for inviting a friend (subject to conditions).
Vouchers cannot be exchanged for cash.
Stars can be used until depleted.
Each voucher has its own redemption and usage period. After expiration, the voucher becomes void.

sections.title: Liability
items: GiftMe.ge reserves the right to change terms and conditions with prior notice.
Accounts will be blocked if fraudulent activity is detected.
GiftMe.ge is not obligated to compensate for damages in case of technical issues.

sections.title: Friend Referral
items: Each user who registers a new user will receive 5 stars.
New users must be 18+ years old.
During registration, new users must enter the inviter's code in the promo code field.
Bonus is credited only when the new user redeems a gift worth at least 15 stars.

sections.title: Mystery Voucher
items: When choosing a mystery voucher, you may receive: iPhone, PlayStation, and more.
The Mystery BOX result is final and cannot be appealed.
Gifts from the mystery box are distributed proportionally.
